name: H07_inspiring_overseer_flying_cannot_be_blocked_by_a_ground_creature
note: Inspiring Overseer has flying: when it attacks, the opponent's ground creature is never offered a block, while the opponent's flying creature is offered one (it may block it or not, NONE). The Overseer, already on the battlefield, is unblocked and deals its 2 damage to the opponent (20 -> 18).
